pois.name: Jardin d'essai du Hamma حديقة التجارب الحامة
pois.intro: The Botanical Garden Hamma is a 32-hectare botanical garden located in the Mohamed Belouizdad district of Algiers. It was established in 1832.

pois.name: المتحف الوطني للفنون والتقاليد الشعبية/دار خداوج العمياء
pois.nameEnglish: Museum of Popular Arts and Traditions
pois.intro: The Museum of Popular Arts and Traditions is an art museum in Algiers, the capital of Algeria. The museum is located on Rue Socgemah in the Souk El-Djemaâ of the Basse-Casbah district and welcomes around 47,000 visitors every year.

pois.name: جامع كتشاوة
pois.intro: The Ketchaoua Mosque, also known as Djamaa Ketchaoua, is a mosque in the city of Algiers, the capital of Algeria. Completed in the 17th century, during Ottoman period, the mosque is located at the foot of the Casbah of Algiers, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and is on the first of the Casbah's many steep stairways.

pois.name: الجامع الجديد
pois.intro: The Djamaʽa el Djedid, also rendered Djamaa al-Djedid, is a mosque in Algiers, the capital of Algeria.

pois.name: Mémorial du martyr
pois.intro: The Maqam Echahid is a concrete monument commemorating the Algerian War. The monument was opened on July 5, 1982, on the 20th anniversary of Algeria's independence.

pois.name: Musée national des beaux-arts d'Alger
pois.nameEnglish: National Museum of Fine Arts of Algiers
pois.wikipedia: en:National Museum of Fine Arts of Algiers
pois.intro: The National Museum of Fine Arts in Algiers is one of the largest art museums in Africa. Opened to the public since 5 May 1930, it is located in the Hamma district, next to the Hamma test garden.

pois.name: Musée public national d’Art moderne et contemporain d’Alger
pois.nameEnglish: Museum of Modern Art of Algiers
pois.wikipedia: fr:Musée public national d’Art moderne et contemporain d’Alger
pois.intro: The Museum of Modern Art of Algiers is an art museum in Algiers. It was inaugurated in 2007.

pois.name: قصر رياس البحر
pois.intro: The Palais des Rais, also known as Bastion 23, is a classified historical monument located in Algiers, Algeria. It is notable for its architecture and for being the last surviving quarter of the lower Casbah of Algiers, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

pois.name: Musée national des antiquités et des arts islamiques
pois.nameEnglish: National Museum of Antiquities and ancient Islamic art
pois.wikipedia: fr:Musée national des antiquités et des arts islamiques
pois.intro: The National Museum of Antiquities and Islamic Art is an art museum in Algiers, Algeria.

pois.name: سجن سركاجي
pois.intro: Serkadji Prison, formerly Barberousse Prison, was a high-security prison in Algiers, Algeria; in 1995, about two-thirds of the 1,500 prisoners detained are accused or convicted of terrorism.

pois.name: Musée National du Bardo
pois.nameEnglish: Bardo National Museum of Prehistory and Ethnography
pois.intro: The Bardo National Museum of Prehistory and Ethnography, is a national museum located in Algiers, Algeria. It was originally a palace built by the Algerian admiral Raïs Hamidou in the late 18th century.

pois.name: مسجد سفير
pois.intro: The Safir Mosque is a Sunni mosque in the city of Algiers, Algeria. The Moorish-style mosque was completed in 1534 CE and is located inside the medina quarter of the Casbah of Algiers, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

pois.name: قصر الداي
pois.intro: Palace of the Dey, also known as Algiers Castle, is an Ottoman era palace in the city of Algiers, Algeria. Completed in the 16th century, it is situated inside the Casbah of Algiers, and settled by successive deys of the city.

pois.name: La villa Sesini
pois.intro: The villa Sésini is a former torture center established in El Madania during the Algerian war in the city of Algiers.

pois.name: Musée Public National de l’Enluminure de la Miniature et de la Calligraphie المتحف العمومي الوطني للزخرفة والمنمنمات وفن الخط
pois.intro: Dar Mustapha Pacha is a Moorish palace, located in the Casbah of Algiers, Algiers, Algeria. It houses the National Museum of Miniatures, Illumination and Calligraphy.

pois.name: المتحف الوطني للآثار والفنون الإسلامية
pois.nameEnglish: National Museum of Antiquities and Islamic Art
pois.intro: The National Museum of Antiquities and Islamic Art is an art museum in Algiers, Algeria.

pois.name: Bordj Moulay Hassen برج مولاي حسن
pois.intro: Bordj Moulay Hassan (arabe : برج مولاي حسن ou fort de l'Empereur était une forteresse ottomane couvrant le sud d'Alger située au sommet de la colline du Savon. Cette citadelle avait été édifiée par le Beylerbey après le siège manqué de la ville par les armées de Charles Quint en 1541.

pois.name: Place de l'Émir-Abdelkader
pois.intro: La place de l'Émir-Abdelkader est une place de la commune d'Alger-Centre, dans la ville d'Alger.

pois.name: Place des Martyrs ⴰⵎⵔⴰⵃ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⵖⵔⴰⵙⵏ ساحة الشهداء
pois.intro: La place des Martyrs est une place publique située au centre d'Alger, dans la commune de Casbah.

pois.name: Villa Abdelatif
pois.intro: The Villa Abd-el-Tif, also known as la Villa Medicis algérienne, is a Moorish villa located in Algiers, Algeria. It is notable for having been set up in 1907 in emulation of the French Academy in Rome, the Villa Medici.

pois.name: مسجد سيدي محمد شريف
pois.intro: La mosquée Sidi M'hamed Cherif se situe dans la haute Casbah d'Alger, au carrefour des rues Sidi M’hamed Chérif et des frères Bachara . Elle est bâtie autour du sanctuaire de Sidi M'hamed Cherif, un saint local décédé aux alentours de 1541–1543, ce qui en fait l’édifice religieux centré autour d’un lieu de dévotion historique.

pois.name: حديقة الحيوانات بن عكنون
pois.intro: Le parc de Ben Aknoun est un parc situé au Sud Ouest d'Alger, en Algérie dans le quartier Saïd Hamdine. Il est situé entre Ben Aknoun et Hydra.

pois.name: Ambassade de France
pois.intro: The Embassy of France in Algiers is France's diplomatic mission to Algeria. Since the country’s independence in 1962, its Chancery has been located in the Peltzer Park neighborhood of Hydra, a suburb of Algiers.

pois.name: Ambassade d'Italie
pois.intro: L'ambasciata d'Italia ad Algeri è la missione diplomatica della Repubblica Italiana presso la Repubblica Democratica Popolare di Algeria. La sede dell'ambasciata si trova a El-Biar, nella Provincia di Algeri.

pois.name: ساحة بور سعيد
pois.intro: Le square Port-Saïd est un jardin algérois faisant le lien entre la basse Casbah et Alger-Centre, ouvert en 1845 ou 1853. Sa superficie totale est de 5 500 m2.

pois.name: Jardin Sofia
pois.intro: Le square Sofia est un jardin algérois. Le jardin est créé sur l'ancien fort de Bab Azzoun, dont une partie subsiste encore de nos jours.

pois.intro: Le parc Beyrouth est un parc algérois situé dans le quartier de Télemly à Alger-Centre. Le parc abrite le musée de l'Enfant depuis 1965.

pois.name: Parc de la Liberté
pois.intro: Le parc de la Liberté est un parc algérois situé entre le boulevard Krim Belkacem et la rue Didouche Mourad. Conçu en 1915 par Charles de Galland.
